method: Independent offline read of 67 actual source and packaged JARs, existing builder.audit, all actual unit XML, compiled Mixin annotations, PNG pixels and archived Git bytes. No rebuild, game launch, publication generation or external writes.
scopeBoundary: Current frozen 67 binaries and tests only. Runtime/manual and platform approval are separate gates; a package audit does not assert current worlds passed.

unchangedBaseline.sidecarComparison: Canonical line contents; Git text normalization changes CRLF to LF on existing sidecars. JAR bytes are compared exactly.

currentProductionChanges.scope: HUD RETURN interception and F1 guard across24; exact concrete Frustum extraction selector on Neo8. These are production class changes, not metadata-only changes.
